title: PS2Rate
wikitext:
== Information ==

Before USB, it was PS2. PS2Rate is a tool made by [[Zibbo]] and [[Perkele]] that overclocked the standard pooling 40hz/sec rate of PS2 connector up to 200hz/sec. This translated in a much smoother mouse feeling and was an indispensible tool to any gamer. Original PS2Rate was made for Windows 98 and earlier.

[[Zibbo]] and [[Perkele]] are now ahead of [http://www.udpsoft.com Udp Soft].
